facts.invalidation: Cover the CORRA receive if Bank of Canada 2027 hikes are delivered or the strip reprices back through the 3.13 entry, especially on a sticky oil-and-goods inflation impulse. Cover the NZ-US short if the 10-year spread cheapens further from minus 23 basis points toward richer New Zealand, including on an RBNZ easing surprise or a Treasury-led selloff that leaves New Zealand yields stuck.

The receive is wrong if March Canada implieds reverse back through 3.13 on an oil-led Bank of Canada re-hike. The cross is wrong if AUDNZD holds above 1.2456 and extends on a Hormuz risk-off that keeps liquidating kiwi. Flatten the new FX if the 99th-percentile stretch persists without any mean-reversion over the tactical window.

Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. A US-only or energy-headline move that leaves CRAH27 unchanged is not invalidation. Wrong timing, not wrong thesis, if implieds chop around 3.13 without a new BoC hike signal.
